description: A PHP static analysis tool for finding errors and security vulnerabilities in PHP applications

latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at master -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* Parse SQL queries to track security analysis taints by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14159
* Add the redirect taint kind, and connect session stores to their reads by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14158
* Give a parameter no sinks with @psalm-taint-sink none by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14230
* Trust the server a request reaches when the URL's host matches a list of hosts by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14170
* Let plugins record what a validation checks, and trust the value once a check on its result says it passed by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14176
* Report escaped values placed where their escaping doesn't protect them by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14400
### Fixes
* Let @psalm- purity tags win over @pure and @phpstan-pure by @shu-chen-dot-ca in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14071
* Pin type variables of new assigned to static properties, property items and property references by @orklah in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14296
* Keep references bound in a loop or branch after it by @orklah in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14283
* fix(reconciler): keep the value type of an array offset when empty() is true by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13087
* Fix: default cache directory when HOME is unset or not writable by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14332
* Fix: type of globals written through another function depends on file analysis order by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/12549
* Report a path the client chooses given to UploadedFileInterface::moveTo() and to the parameters inheriting a sink by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14227
* fix(type): a callable is never falsy by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14322
* fix(docblock): two interfaces documenting the same signature document the implementation by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14361
* fix(assertions): a false $a !== $b gives both operands the type of the other by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13365
* fix(call): the out type of a by-ref param reads the templates bound by later arguments by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13435
* fix(docblock): callable param types with the same inner parameter name are not duplicated tags by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14327
* Infer loop variables reassigned from their own method call, property or offset by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14392
* Keep the template of a variable identical to a literal by @orklah in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14398
### Docs
* Turn the security analysis overview into a tutorial by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14228
### Internal changes
* Fix master self-analysis: mark cache-directory env vars as operator-chosen by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14378
* Share the integer comparison narrowing of the two simple reconcilers by @orklah in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14307
* Merge the assertion finders of < and > comparisons by @orklah in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14395


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/compare/7.12.0...7.13.0

detail.readme:
Psalm

[![Packagist](https://img.shields.io/packagist/v/vimeo/psalm.svg)](https://packagist.org/packages/vimeo/psalm) [![Packagist](https://img.shields.io/packagist/dt/vimeo/psalm.svg)](https://packagist.org/packages/vimeo/psalm) [![Psalm coverage](https://shepherd.dev/github/vimeo/psalm/coverage.svg?)](https://shepherd.dev/github/vimeo/psalm) [![Psalm level](https://shepherd.dev/github/vimeo/psalm/level.svg?)](https://psalm.dev/) Psalm is a static analysis tool for finding errors in PHP applications. [Join the official Psalm news channel](https://t.me/psalmphp) and the Psalm community on [Telegram](https://t.me/psalmphp_community) and [Discord](https://discord.gg/RwH8rEpxt9)! ## Installation To get started, check out the [installation guide](docs/running_psalm/installation.md). ## Live Demo You can play around with Psalm [on its website](https://psalm.dev/). ## Documentation Documentation is available on [Psalm’s website](https://psalm.dev/docs), generated from the [docs](https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/blob/master/docs) folder. ## Support Psalm development You can support Psalm development by requesting a support contract from [Daniil Gentili](https://daniil.it), the only active maintainer of Psalm. Support contracts can cover full integration of Psalm into existing codebases, support for Psalm issues and development of additional Psalm features. See [here »](https://daniil.it) for info, pricing and contact information. ## Interested in contributing? Have a look at [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Who made this Built by Matt Brown ([@muglug](https://github.com/muglug)). Maintained by Daniil Gentili ([@danog](https://github.com/danog)), Alies Lapatsin ([@alies-dev](https://github.com/alies-dev)) and Orklah ([@orklah](https://github.com/orklah)). Former maintainer: Bruce Weirdan ([@weirdan](https://github.com/weirdan)). The engineering team at [Vimeo](https://github.com/vimeo) have provided a lot encouragement, especially [@nbeliard](https://github.com/nbeliard), [@erunion](https://github.com/erunion) and [@nickyr](https://github.com/nickyr).
